Your information, explained

Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 29, 2026
App: Budgetly · Developer: Marliardo Umbao

Budgetly stores your records locally. No account is required. You decide when to export or share a backup.

1. Information stored by the app

Budgetly stores information you enter: your display name, selected avatar and border, income and expense transactions, budgets, savings goals, calendar events, reminders, notes, and grocery lists.

It also stores preferences such as currency, theme and notification settings, dates you open the app for streaks and avatar rewards, backup timestamps, and the folder location you select for automatic backups.

2. How your information is used

The app uses these records to display your finances and reports, track budgets and goals, manage your plans, schedule local reminders, calculate streaks, and create or restore backups you request.

Budgetly does not require an online account, connect to your bank accounts, or process payments.

3. Collection, tracking and sharing

The current app does not send your budgeting records to developer-operated servers. It includes no advertising SDKs, third-party analytics, or tracking tools. The developer does not sell your information.

Your operating system, app store, and any services you choose to use may process information under their own privacy policies.

4. Backups and file permissions

You can export a JSON backup and restore a backup file you select. On supported Android devices, you may enable automatic backups to a folder chosen through the system file picker. The app uses access to those selected files and folders for backup and restore.

Backups contain personal and financial records and are not encrypted by Budgetly. Exporting or importing may also create temporary files in app cache. Protect your backup files and share them only with recipients you trust.

If you save or share a backup using email, messaging, cloud storage, or another service, that provider handles the copy under its own policies. Device backup services may also store app data depending on your device settings.

5. Notifications

With your permission, Budgetly schedules local bill, event, and streak reminders on your device. Reminder content may include event titles, amounts, and due dates. This information may appear on your lock screen depending on your device settings.

You can disable reminders in Budgetly or change notification permissions and preview visibility in your device settings.

6. Storage and security

Records are kept in local application storage. Budgetly does not add its own encryption to these records or exported backups. Their protection also depends on your device security and the locations and services you choose for backups. No storage method can guarantee complete security.

7. Retention and deletion

Your records remain in app storage until you change or delete them, reset the app, or your device removes the app data. You can edit or delete records within the app.

To reset your stored records and profile, choose Profile → Clear All Data. This turns off automatic backups. It does not delete previously exported backup files or copies stored in other services. Delete those separately using your file manager or the relevant service. Restoring an old backup can bring back records contained in that file.

8. Children

Budgetly does not knowingly collect children’s personal information through developer-operated servers. Information entered into the app is handled locally as described above. Parents and guardians should supervise children’s use of financial records and backup sharing.

9. This website

This website presents information about Budgetly and does not request your financial records. It contains no custom analytics, advertising trackers, or contact form. The hosting provider may process technical request information, such as IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and protect the website. This website’s hosting is separate from the app’s local storage.

10. Policy updates

This policy may change as Budgetly’s features or data practices change. Updated text will be published on this page with a revised effective date.

11. Contact

Budgetly is developed by Marliardo Umbao. For privacy questions, use the developer contact details provided on the app’s store listing when available.
